name: gpu-crab
description: While a local-llm tool runs on your Ollama box, a crab on a treadmill shows the loaded model, VRAM, GPU/CPU split and elapsed time above the prompt (amber when a model spills to CPU), and /gpu keeps a 'kept on the LAN' tally of what local models read instead of the cloud.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server the local-llm MCP server talks to; read with GET /api/ps only.

vramGb.title: GPU memory (GB)
vramGb.description: The card's VRAM, for the meter (an RTX 3070 has 8).

toolPrefix.title: Tool prefix
toolPrefix.description: Tools whose names start with this light the band.
